limitations: Procedural KCC+IK gait, not mocap and not a fully physically controlled walking biped.
Culled actors still use 5 Hz pose updates; visible actors use the simulation/render cadence, no promise of a fixed real-world FPS.
Visible actors cost more pose updates; duplicate leg IK and eight redundant angular motors per character removed. No user-GPU performance claim.

Before/after metrics are controlled synthetic trajectories on a real in-game character, not a human realism score. Per-character runtime gait scaling was not seeded; small differences may include individual cadence variation. Full unselected results are included.

Not every peak improved: some knee angular-velocity peaks and tiny pelvis movements in creep are larger. Support constraints can still force an immediate reach correction on abrupt transitions or unusual terrain.
Temporary fall/get-up remain the v6 hybrid: dynamic articulated fall and support/clearance-gated animated recovery, not physical self-righting.
Not exhaustive for all maps, body scales, equipment, aim actions, stairs and simultaneous crowd collisions.
Active-body laboratory is unchanged, its full balance/gait acceptance remains incomplete.
